statement: For even x<y with distinct odd square-root outputs a<b, K=(b-a)(a+b)/(y-x) lies in [2/3,2). For every odd a>=5, the fully guarded E pairs (a²+1,(a+3)²-2) and ((a+1)²-2,(a+2)²+1), with outputs(a,a+2), give K=2/3 and K=2(a+1)/(a+3), respectively. The genuine floor-to-ideal secant ratio (b-a)/(sqrt(y)-sqrt(x)) lies in (2/3,2), with both limits sharp along these families. All local states lie below a³-a², so increasing the minimum and imposing the existing smooth height exclusions does not yield a uniform 1+o(1) relative E-gap error. In contrast O relative error is <1/(3sqrt(m)) for odd inputs above m. Guarded open-block obstruction, not a periodic counterexample or a new cycle restriction. AI-assisted symbolic proof, independently cross-checked by another AI; not independent human review.

For every integer r>=9 with r=1 mod4, put m=r²,K=r²-1,h=K²+1,M=K³+3K/2,t=r³-(3r+1)/2,q=r³, s-=m²+1 and s+=m²+2m-1. Exact actual guarded edges are h->O M->E t and s±->E m->O q, with m,h,t,q odd and M,s± even. The mixed gap contracts for both choices, yet Delta_B=s^(3/4)-h^(3/4)-(q-t) is <-1/2 at s- and >r at s+. The shared m,h,M,t,q and their cells are unchanged; only the E-source position in m's square cell changes. The deficit m³-M>2m² places these examples below all current smooth height-excluded strips, including the sharp later exponent when its cutoff is met. Thus the full local mixed cells and guards do not force either sign. No common terminal P/Q realization or periodic orbit is supplied; a genuinely cyclic weighted comparison remains open. AI-assisted symbolic proof with exact fixed controls, not Lean or independent human review.
